rows.subtype: Approach: adds buffer days before a deadline [Thinking]

rows.subtype: Approach: keeps some money aside in a monthly budget for surprises [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: pads every task so heavily that work expands to fill it [Pitfall]
rows.description: A colleague adds a large buffer to every estimate, and the team relaxes and finishes at the last minute anyway. The padding never turned into saved time.

rows.subtype: Approach: keeps one shared buffer at the end of the project [Revision]
rows.description: The team removes padding from tasks and holds a single buffer before the deadline, using it only when a real delay occurs.

rows.subtype: Approach: builds a simple version first and improves it [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: releases a small first version and asks users for feedback [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: decides the smallest useful version and defers extras [Thinking]

rows.subtype: Approach: ships something too thin to be useful and learns little [Pitfall]

rows.subtype: Approach: revises the minimum to include the core value and repeats short cycles [Revision]

rows.subtype: Approach: changes one variable and measures the result [Action]
